blurb: Guests can rent single and tandem kayaks, canoes, paddleboards, and pedal boats at the marina on Terrace Drive. Rentals require participants to be at least 16 years old to operate vessels unless accompanied by someone over 19. All participants must complete a waiver, and those under 16 must wear USCG approved life vests at all times.
